info.name: Courier & Logistics Management Platform API
info.description: Full API collection for the Courier & Logistics Management Platform backend (B7A6 assignment). Covers Auth, Users, Riders, Hubs, Shipments, Tracking, Payments (bKash) and Analytics across Customer, Rider and Admin roles.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email (valid 5 minutes).
Enter the OTP received by email. Creates the account and logs in.
Account is created but stays PENDING until an admin approves it (see Riders folder).
Body must be form-data with a single file field named 'profileImage'.
Will fail with 400 if the hub still has active shipments.

request.description: Example only — will 400 if the shipment is already DELIVERED. Use on a fresh shipment to demo.
Only works while status is PENDING or ASSIGNED.
Returns a bkashURL — open it in a browser to complete the sandbox payment. bKash then redirects to /payments/callback.
